title: Weekly metrics provider file
description: One tool's aggregate numbers for one ISO week. A tool writes it to ~/.local/share/<tool>/metrics/weekly-<YYYY-Www>.json. Only tool, version, week, and machine_id are strings; every metric is a number. Copy this file as is into sibling tools.

machine_id.description: Random id made on this machine. It is not derived from any hardware or account.
